body: The sketch is on TASK-1750 (latest comment). Two start-identity formats exist: rfc3339 (canonical) and linux-starttime ticks (cache_lock). Switching formats outright would reclaim live locks after an upgrade. The proposal moves the exact identity into liveness.rs and makes process_identity_is_alive compare by scheme; it is behaviour-neutral for existing records. Strict-tier. I will implement after signoff. Slices 3/4 are in PRs #2627 and #2628.
subject: SIGNOFF? TASK-1750 cache_lock identity consolidation sketch
